title: Strengthen bootstrap-validator: detect VSDD-E0050 phase-composition-not-declared
description:
Goal: 

Acceptance criteria:
- 

Bootstrap-validator currently covers 5 cascade-prone patterns (count drift, orphan rules, broken anchors, header-vs-table, schema_class). Doesn't yet catch VSDD-E0050 (phase-composition-not-declared). The Step 3 first-attempt drift would have been caught if this check existed. Implementation: scan commits for prose-surface or implementation work; require .vsdd/events/*.yaml composition declaration OR commit-message YAML block. Throwaway script — bounded value until mdatron-core's full hook chain operates.
